# The Gallitano Studio

> The Gallitano Studio advises C-suite executives and enterprise leadership benches on narrative authority, reputation architecture, and presence where it matters most. For senior executives, and the ones on their way.

The Gallitano Studio is Gallitano Creative LLC. Founder: Angela Gallitano. Website: https://thegallitanostudio.com/

A plain summary of the site for AI systems and search tools. The wording below is taken from the site. Last updated: 2026-10-28.

## Who it is

- Angela Gallitano is the founder of The Gallitano Studio, an executive story and presence advisory.
- For senior executives, and the ones on their way: CxOs, SVPs, VPs, board directors and executive teams.
- For companies: I partner with CEOs, CHROs, and executive sponsors to calibrate individual leadership authority so it reinforces institutional credibility, board trust, and commercial momentum.
- Selected as 1 of 3 Global Rock Your Profile Leaders at LinkedIn. Set the engagement standard for ambassadors delivering it. Then Gartner, working with CHROs, CIOs and their executive teams. Today, Salesforce Enterprise AI. I architect, deploy, and scale agentic workflows across my own team every day, and I teach leaders to do the same.
- 350+ rooms since 2020. 125+ executives one to one. 15+ industries.
- Global footprint: The US, the UK, EMEA and APAC.
- Based in Huntsville and Madison, Alabama.
- 2022: Gallitano Creative, "The Art of Personal Storytelling." Helping Directors and VPs tell their story, position for their next role and negotiate total compensation: interviews, branded materials, résumés, LinkedIn and thought leadership.
- 2026: The Gallitano Studio. Executive advisory on narrative, reputation and presence for C-suite leaders and enterprise leadership teams.
- The Gallitano Studio is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by any employer.

## What she does

Executive presence is no longer confined to the boardroom. It precedes you.

Your story is already being told. The question is who's telling it.

No one can write your leadership story for you. Together, we name what you've built and the ground only you can claim. Then we make sure it's found in the right places, at the moments that matter.

- Before the first meeting
- Before the board interview
- On the stage
- Every time they search your name

## Programs for leaders

- [Known For First Look](https://thegallitanostudio.com/work-with-me/first-look/): the 2-week strategic narrative sprint. Your career outran your public presence. In two weeks, we align them. You leave with your Known For Leadership Thesis, your Executive Dossier (LinkedIn, executive bio and résumé) and the Calibration readout. The timeline: a tailored intake, a 60-minute extraction session, the build, a 30-minute readout and 15-minute final calibration sessions. Investment: $4,500, one fixed fee. The full First Look fee is credited toward Known For Executive within 90 days.
- [Known For Executive](https://thegallitanostudio.com/work-with-me/executive/): one program, two ways in. Private Client: a 6-month retainer. Company-Sponsored: 3, 6 or 9 months, with the Known For Scorecard for the sponsor (counts and averages, never names or quotes). It opens with a 30-day foundation sprint. A monthly strategic session, plus one 30-minute prep session a month and a second in months with a board, earnings or investor date. Up to four short reviews a month (one short item and one round of feedback each), with replies within two business days; larger work is scheduled separately. Phone a friend for the moments that matter is included in the fixed fee; it is separate from the reviews, does not count against planned prep, and is not always-on access. Your own site on your own domain is an optional add-on for Private Clients, with a separately quoted fixed build fee; annual maintenance is optional and scoped separately.
- [ExecutiveOS](https://thegallitanostudio.com/executiveos/): one leader's AI, built for them inside the tools their company already approves. It knows their story, their voice and the work in front of them. How AI helps a leader work.
- [Leadership AEO](https://thegallitanostudio.com/executiveos/#leadership-aeo): a review of how AI tools describe a leader, and help improving the public sources they draw on. Separate from ExecutiveOS. No ranking guarantees, no control of AI answers, no ongoing monitoring.

## For companies

- [Known For Leadership Collective](https://thegallitanostudio.com/for-companies/#collective): for the bench. Enterprise cohort advisory, 30 to 90 days. It opens with Known For Live, an intensive alignment session with the full leadership group, then structured 1:1 advisory sessions with each executive. ExecutiveOS is optional and priced per leader.
- [Known For Live](https://thegallitanostudio.com/for-companies/#live): for the retreat. The executive alignment intensive, half day to multi-day, on-site or virtual. Offered on its own or as the opening of the Leadership Collective.
- [Known For Executive, Company-Sponsored](https://thegallitanostudio.com/for-companies/#sponsor): for the successor. Known For Executive, paid for by the company, for a single executive. 3, 6 or 9 months.
- [The business case](https://thegallitanostudio.com/for-companies/business-case/)

## How it works

The Known For Method, three stages: Narrative Diagnostic. The Known For Architecture. Where it shows up.

Your LinkedIn and your bio are collateral. The work is narrative architecture and category ownership.

Every engagement is strictly guarded, so you'll see roles here, never names.

Known For First Look is $4,500. Investment for every other program will be shared in our 20-minute conversation.
